main_text.p: cujus. ἦτε eratis & ἦτε fitis. ἐξιδύνατε investigatis & ἐξιδύνατε investigate. Johan.5.39. γινώ- σκετε cognoscunt & Rom.7. v.1. γινώσκεσθε cognoscentibus. Deut.28.57. ἐν τῇ Θλίψει (dat. singul.) ἡ Θλίψει (3.sing. fut.1. act. indic.) σε ὁ ἐχθρός σε. πείσομαι persuadebo & πείσομαι patiar. Johan.17. 6. σοὶ ἦσαν utrum hic σοὶ sit dativus à σὺ vel num.pl. à σὲς. Hebraei dicunt [?] Sic Rom.12. ἐμοὶ ἡ ἐκδίκησις pro ἐμὴ ἡ ἐκδίκησις. Hebraismus idem. ἡ πόσις, ως potio, & ὁ πόσις, maritus; μὴν tamen & μὴν, μηνὸς, mensis.

Sæpe utrolibet modo tempora quæ coincidere dicuntur, accipere licet. Verbi gratia, perinde est utrum dicas εἶπω esse a.1.act. vel a.2. act. subj. Johan.11.10. ἀποκλείνωσιν utrum sit a.1.act.subj. vel praes. act.subj. γέγραφα utrum sit praeteriti activi vel medii.

Nonnunquam distinguit significatio, ut ἔστησαν stiterunt Act.1. v.23. & ἔστησαν stetérunt Luc.17.12. quorum illud esse a.1.act. hoc vero a.2. act. ostendit significatio. Sic τρυγητὸς ὁ vindemia, fructuum collectio. τρυγητὸς ὁ vero tempus vindemia. At ἀμητὸς ὁ messis tempus, sed ἀμητὸς ὁ messis.
Sæpe genus distinguit, ut ἁλς ἁλὸς ὁ sal. ἁλς ἁλὸς ἡ mare, βάτος ἡ rubus, βάτος ὁ menfura liquidorum. Vocalis ut, νῶτος ὁ dorsum, νότος ὁ notus, ventus. consona. νόθος ὁ spurius, &c.

page.notes: The left margin notes are faint and mostly unreadable on the scan; they are not transcribed. Greek and Hebrew readings are approximate and may contain errors; the Hebrew word after "Hebraei dicunt" is doubtful.
